safety.wrong: !pass and outcome not in {abstained,empty}, even when hedged; incomplete substantive answers are wrong
safety.unit: conversation wrong-fraction difference over all 30 planned answers

benefit.unit: conversation correct-fraction difference over all 30 planned answers

missingData.policy: Never drop planned slots. Missing, invalid and duplicate planned slots may pass only under every gate’s worst-case completion, within the registered per-arm cap and with no unknown rows. No incomplete scope has a complete-case interval. Conservative completion bounds apply to paired wrong differences against pack and native. Complete audit material is required.

decision: Pass only if every necessary gate passes, integrity is complete or within the registered worst-case-completion cap with no unknown rows, controller admission is admissible, and audit is complete. Otherwise fail when established, else inconclusive; no outcome-dependent extension. One-sided 95% conversation-paired bounds make no simultaneous-coverage claim. Cold-rebuild and any-wrong risks/discordances are descriptive only. Eligibility is limited to the registered reader/extractor model references; never automatic default enablement.
